steps.say: Some diseases are caused by tiny living things: viruses, bacteria, parasites and fungi. They are called microbes or germs.
Germs spread in different ways. Some spread through dirty water or food. Others spread through the air when people cough, or by touch.
Good hygiene helps stop disease. Wash your hands, use clean water, cook food well and keep food covered.
The body has defences. Skin forms a barrier. Stomach acid kills many germs, and tiny hairs and mucus in the nose catch dirt and germs.
The body also has white blood cells that fight germs, and vaccines help the body get ready to fight a germ in advance.
